title: Oakwing 172 Airplane
body:
"This beast of airplane can travel the skies like a breeze! It comes with two seats, cruise control, and more"

The Oakwing 172 is an airplane that can be purchased from Alan's Auto for $150,000. This is one of the first flying vehicles added to the game, second one being Oak-900 Helicopter. Both can alternatively be obtained by buying a Flight Bundle for 399 Robux via the terminal next to the central display case

Details

When driven, oakwing can achieve top speed of ~220 studs/second and ~70 studs/second in freefall state

Oakwing is a white aircraft with randomly choosen color patterns. Likely, oakwing has many rare variations like other vehicles does. Alternatively, you can choose on of basic aircraft's color (249 robux) and text on License plate (79 robux) in spawner's modification tab

Oakwing can haul and anchor objects in it's cabine, which is usefull for quickly transporting small shipments from shops

Upgrades

Airplane Banner Upgrade, $12,000

It's a yellow toolbox which can be used on Oakwing 172's spawner to upgrade it. Upgrading it will attach customizable banner to your plane
